etymologies.heading: Etymology
paragraphs: 1575, from Late Latin ēlabōrātus (“worked out”), past participle of ēlabōrō (“to work out”), from ē- (“out, forth, fully”) + labor (“work, toil, exertion”). More at e-, labour.
senses: (transitive) Тo develop in detail or complexity.
(dated) To draw out, elicit, expel, or express.
